english: Hello English learners and welcome back to EnglishPod. My name is Marco.

english: That's right I remember when we used to do this in my family it was one of my favorite times of the year.
chinese: 那是，我记得在我家的时候，这是我们最喜欢的一年中的时光。

english: I'm home. Everyone come here. I bought a Christmas tree. Look at this beautiful pine tree.
chinese: 我回家了，大家过来。我买了一棵圣诞树。看看这棵美丽的松树。

english: Wow it's huge. Are you sure it will fit in the living room?
chinese: 哇，太大了。真的能放进客厅吗？

english: Awesome. I'll go get the Christmas lights. Of course it will. Help me put it in the living room.
chinese: 好的，我去做圣诞灯。当然会的，帮我放到客厅里。

english: I found the lights. I got the Christmas ornaments. We could also place these stockings next to the chimney.
chinese: 找到了灯光，得到了圣诞装饰品。我们还可以把这些袜子放在壁炉旁。

english: Great idea. While we decorate the tree we can listen to some good old Christmas songs.
chinese: 好主意。装饰圣诞树的时候我们可以听听一些老歌。

english: All right we're back and as we mentioned the entire dialogue is about a Christmas tree.
chinese: 好的，我们回来了，正如我们提到的，整个对话都是关于一棵圣诞树。

english: So why don't you explain what a Christmas tree is because many people maybe don't even do or buy Christmas trees.
chinese: 所以你能不能解释一下圣诞树是什么呢，因为很多人可能根本就没买也没做圣诞树。

english: Okay well Christmas tree is usually a green tree that we cut down and we put in the house.
chinese: 好的，圣诞树通常是我们在家摆放的一棵绿色的树。

english: So it's not a real tree with roots in the ground but sometimes it comes from a real tree outside and the tree is very small on the top and it goes out like a triangle.
chinese: 所以这不是一棵真的长在地下的树，但有时它会从外面的一棵真树上生长出来，而且这棵树顶部很小，长得像一个三角形。

english: Okay so it's a special shape and we generally make it look very pretty with lights and ornaments and decorations and on Christmas on the 25th or the 24th it depends where you come from.
chinese: 好的，它是特殊形状的，在灯光和装饰品等亮光下看起来非常漂亮。圣诞节在12月25日或24日，这取决于你来自哪里。

english: We put lots of presents underneath the Christmas tree.
chinese: 我们把很多礼物放在圣诞树下。

english: Wow it sounds amazing. Well yeah and it looks very nice.
chinese: 哇，听起来真是太棒了。嗯，看起来也很nice。

english: It does look really beautiful and it's just a really special part of Christmas.
chinese: 它看起来真的很美丽，只是圣诞节里特别的一角。

english: And well as you mentioned sometimes the tree is just a fake plastic tree but many times it's a real tree and the type of tree that you use is a pine tree.
chinese: 而且正如你所说，有时候树只是一个假塑料树，但很多时候它是真的松树。

english: Exactly and so pine tree is a kind of tree that doesn't have leaves. It has needles.
chinese: 确切地说，松树是一种没有叶子的树，它有针状物。

english: That means that they're long very thin green pieces that are all over the tree and you can see these trees in most northern places like Scandinavia or in America maybe Illinois and Minnesota and Michigan and Vermont.
chinese: 那就是树上有很多很细的绿色长条，遍布整棵树，在北欧或者美国的伊利诺伊州、明尼苏达州、密歇根州和佛蒙特州等地可以看到这样的树木。

english: And they're very as you say very unique trees but they also have a very special smell, the smell of pine.
chinese: 而且正如你说的，它们非常独特，而且还有特别的松香味。

english: They do. It's very nice.
chinese: 它们是的，很好。

english: It's such a nice smell that a lot of the things that we use in America to clean our houses have a pine smell because it makes the house smell nice.
chinese: 这种香味非常nice，我们美国用来打扫房子的很多东西都有松木的味道，因为这样能让房子闻起来好。

english: Very good. So a pine tree. The dad brought a pine tree or a Christmas tree home and well the wife was a little bit worried if it will fit.
chinese: 非常好。一棵松树。爸爸把一棵松树或者圣诞树带回家，妻子有点担心它放得下。

english: Okay will it fit? This is a very important question because a lot of pine trees are very very tall.
chinese: 好的，它能装得下吗？这是一个非常重要的问题，因为有很多松树非常高。

english: So if a pine tree is three meters tall or four meters tall will it fit? Is the question we ask? Is it too big or is it going to be stuck on the ceiling in the house?
chinese: 那么一棵三米高的松树或者四米高的松树会合适吗？我们问的问题是？太大了还是会被卡在房顶上呢？

english: And so we could ask this about anything. I just bought a new TV.
chinese: 而我们就可以问这个问题了。我刚买了一台新电视。

english: Will it fit in the living room?
chinese: 它能放进客厅里吗？

english: I don't know. I'm very nervous. I spend a lot of money.
chinese: 我不知道，我很紧张。我花了很多钱。

english: Well you were talking about the Christmas tree and how you put a lot of nice decorations on it. So we say that we decorate the tree.
chinese: 这么说你提到圣诞树，怎么在上面挂了很多漂亮的装饰品。所以我们说我们给树打扮。

english: That's right. So the verb here, this is an action word, to decorate. So every holiday season in my family we take one day and we decorate the tree.
chinese: 没错。这里动词是动作词，是用来装饰的意思。所以每年 holidays 我们家都会抽出一天来装饰圣诞树。

english: That means that we take very small special ornaments and ribbons and lights and we put them on the tree to make the tree look pretty.
chinese: 这意味着我们用非常小的特殊装饰品、丝带和灯光放在树上，让树看起来很漂亮。

english: You can also say decorate the house or to decorate the house for a party. So this means to make something look special or pretty.
chinese: 你也可以说装饰房子或者为派对装饰房子。也就是说，让它看起来特别或漂亮。

english: The first one we've already mentioned it goes together with the phrase to decorate the tree.
chinese: 我们之前提到的第一步与装饰树的短语一起使用。

english: What do we decorate the tree with Marco?
chinese: Marco，我们用什么装饰树呢？

english: You mentioned ornaments. Christmas ornaments.
chinese: 你提到了装饰品。圣诞装饰品。

english: Christmas ornaments. So an ornament is a thing. It's something that we use to make something else look prettier.
chinese: 圣诞装饰品。饰品是一种东西，我们用来让其他东西看起来更漂亮。

english: In this case ornaments are sometimes round and red or green or gold. We hang them on the tree.
chinese: 在这种情况下，有时候装饰物是圆形的、红色或绿色或金色的。我们把它们挂在树上。

english: In this case it's a Christmas ornament for the tree. But an ornament can be anything.
chinese: 在这种情况下，是一个圣诞树装饰品。但装饰品可以是任何东西。

english: Any nice piece of art or something that you can use to decorate your house.
chinese: 任何漂亮的艺术品或可以装饰你家的东西。

english: Exactly. In my family ornaments aren't just those round circles or balls for Christmas.
chinese: 正是如此。我家的装饰物不仅仅是圣诞节用的那些圆形圆环或球状物。

english: Every family member has a special kind of ornament. So my dad has Santa Claus ornaments.
chinese: 每个家庭成员都有某种特殊的装饰。所以我爸爸有圣诞老人的装饰。

english: And my mom has bunny rabbit ornaments. And I have angel ornaments. So everybody has a special one.
chinese: 而我妈妈有兔子装饰品。我有天使装饰品。所以每个人都有一个特别的。

english: That's really nice. And well apart from ornaments there is also the tradition of hanging stockings.
chinese: 那真是不错。而且除了装饰品之外，还有挂袜子的传统。

english: Okay. So a stocking you might have heard this word before in the sense of a clothing item. A stocking is like a sock.
chinese: 好的。所以你可能听说过“袜子”这个词，指的是衣物类商品。“袜子”就像袜子一样。

english: A big sock.
chinese: 一条大裤衩。

english: And it also means old stockings that women would wear. Like tights.
chinese: 而且意味着女性会穿的旧丝袜。就像紧身裤一样。

english: But in this case a stocking, a Christmas stocking is a very very very big sock that we hang.
chinese: 但在这情况下，一条圣诞袜是一个非常非常大的袜子，我们挂在墙上。

english: And on Christmas we get to fill it with very special things like candy and toys.
chinese: 而圣诞节我们就可以把它填满各种特别的东西，比如糖果和玩具。

chinese: 糖果很好玩。所以实际上你们是把袜子挂在烟囱那里吗？

english: That's right. So there's a fireplace and usually above the fireplace there's a shelf we call it a mantle.
chinese: 没错。通常在壁炉上方有一个我们称之为壁龛的架子。

english: And there's a place there to hang these. And the place where all of the smoke from the fire comes out is the chimney.
chinese: 并且那里有一个地方可以挂这些。所有的火焰冒出的烟从烟囱里出来。

english: It's also the place where Santa Claus comes down.
chinese: 这也是圣诞老人降临的地方。

chinese: [Error]

english: And the tube that goes up and where the smoke comes out of is called the chimney.
chinese: 而通往上部的管子，烟从那里冒出，被称为烟囱。

chinese: 明白了。原来你根本不想住那里。然后这个笑话是说圣诞老人肯定太胖了，爬不进烟囱里去。

english: But it's a special place in the Christmas story because that's what Santa Claus does.
chinese: 但这是圣诞故事中一个特别的地方，因为那是雪人先生所做的。

chinese: 好主意。装饰圣诞树的时候我们可以听听一些老圣诞节歌曲。

chinese: 这真是，我不知道，有时候很铺张的一件事。

chinese: 是的，人们在不仅花费时间而且花钱装饰房子上是多么喜欢这样做都快让人觉得好笑了。

english: Because as we say some of them can be very, very nice and they take a lot of time and effort into decorating it.
